lines: A fishing joke needs a good <wavy>line</wavy> and someone patient enough to hear it.
I caught a fish this big once. Luckily, my hands were closer together then.
The river and I had an argument. It refused to take my side.
I asked a cod for directions. It just stared like I was the lost one.
My best hook is honest. It never promises what it cannot catch.
A gull stole my lunch, then complained about the seasoning.
I named my boat Patience because it spends most days waiting.
The trout heard my joke and left without paying.
I tried fishing without bait. The fish respected my confidence.
My net has one talent. It finds every stick in the river.
A sailor told me the sea was friendly. His boat had not met the weather yet.
I keep telling the same fish story. The fish gets larger because it is still growing.
The dock creaks whenever I lie about the catch.
I know why fish travel in schools. They saw what happened to the ones who skipped class.
A crab pinched me for touching its dinner. Fair enough.
The rain joined me at the lake. It brought more water than I needed.
I bought a lucky lure. So far, it has been very lucky at avoiding fish.
The boat is not leaking. It is letting the lake visit.
I asked the tide to wait. It had somewhere else to be.
A knot walked into the tavern. It swore it was not tied to anyone.
